intro: Across cryptocurrency, technology, financial services, software development, and finance, 11 articles published between 13 April and 8 October 2026 examine North Korea-linked activity affecting Global, Asia, Europe, North America, and China. Lazarus Group, Alluring Pisces, and APT37 each appear among the tracked threat actors. The severity mix comprises nine high and one critical item, reflecting sustained targeting of digital-asset and financial infrastructure alongside software supply chains. Coverage spans intrusions, campaigns, and sector-specific incidents attributed to these distinct groups, with cryptocurrency and financial services recurring most often across the reporting period.
